title: Exploring a World of Tech
sourceReference: Lesson 1B — Exploring a World of Tech
objective: Recognise how technology shapes daily life and future careers, and understand computers as systems.
lessonSummary:
Technology touches almost everything you do in a day — how you communicate, learn, shop, get paid, and find work. Understanding that isn't just background knowledge: employers expect people to be comfortable adapting to new tools, because the tools keep changing.

A computer system is the combination of hardware (the physical parts) and software (the instructions that make the hardware useful) working together to take in information, process it, and produce a result. Knowing this basic system view helps you troubleshoot calmly instead of guessing — if something isn't working, it's either a hardware problem, a software problem, or how they're communicating with each other.
keyFocusAreas: How does technology impact my daily life?
How could technology impact my future and my future career?
What are some facts about computing history?
